purpose: Factor AxTask's proven repo-local coordination-ledger discipline into a versioned cross-repository adoption contract without moving consumer task state or domain authority into BlacksmithGuild.

donor.authority: AxTask remains authoritative for AxTask queue contents, AXQ namespace, production/recovery tasks, authority identifiers, and product/deployment behavior.

portableContract.ledgerRole: One repo-local coordination ledger records unfinished work and continuation state; implementation authority remains in the repository's own code, contracts, tests, runbooks, issues, PRs, and current evidence.
portableContract.doneNextAction: none; no safe actionable work remains
invariants: Read the repo-local ledger at intake before choosing unfinished work.
Claim before substantial mutation and re-read current ledger state before updating a claim.
Continuation states are not stopping states when safe authorized work remains.
Opening a PR is not completion.
BLOCKED and OPERATOR require an exact gate and first executable next action.
DONE requires the acceptance gate, durable proof, Gate: none, and the canonical no-safe-work-remains next action.
Preserve concurrent work; never erase or rewrite another active task merely to simplify convergence.

compatibility.pinPolicy: Consumers must pin an exact 40-hex BlacksmithGuild commit containing this contract and an exact 40-hex donor commit. Symbolic refs such as main, HEAD, tags, or branches are rejected.
compatibility.upgradePolicy: A consumer changes its pinned contract commit only in an explicit compatibility update that reruns its own validator. No consumer follows BlacksmithGuild main implicitly.
compatibility.majorVersionRule: Breaking portable vocabulary, task-field, status, or proof-token changes require a new RepoLedgerInteroperability major version.

requirements: Keep the runtime ledger inside the consumer repository.
Use a consumer-owned task namespace; do not copy AXQ identifiers outside AxTask.
Implement and run a consumer-owned validator for local queue semantics.
Keep local product, deployment, runtime, secrets, and proof authority in the consumer repository.
Treat the adoption manifest as compatibility metadata, not proof that any queued task is complete.
Fail closed on symbolic or malformed contract/donor refs.
consumerContract.mayStrengthen: Consumers may add stricter local fields, states, gates, or proof requirements if they do not silently weaken this version's portable invariants.
mustNotReimplement: BlacksmithGuild as a central runtime queue or task scheduler

classification.portable_harness: adopt the coordination-ledger lifecycle and invariant vocabulary
classification.reusable_skill: reference-only; reuse existing repo factoring/interoperability skills rather than create a second skill authority
classification.shared_schema_or_evidence_packet: adopt RepoLedgerAdoption.v1 for compatibility/provenance metadata; it is not runtime proof
classification.adapter: consumer-owned local queue, namespace, intake pointer, and validator
classification.reference_only_doctrine: AxTask queue prose and BlacksmithGuild interoperability doctrine explain provenance but do not become consumer product authority
classification.domain_specific_rejected: AXQ task bodies, AxTask production recovery/deployment details, authority IDs, and consumer product/runtime behavior remain local

forbiddenScope: centralizing consumer queue contents in BlacksmithGuild
making BlacksmithGuild required for consumer build or runtime
copying AxTask production/recovery task bodies into another repository
using adoption metadata to claim queued task completion or live behavior
cross-repository mutation from a consumer validator
circular authority where a consumer owns or redefines this shared contract
